Natural realistic comic proportions and credible seated anatomy. Strong slightly rough black ink contours, readable simplified shapes, hard two-tone cel shaded planes, restrained hand-drawn graphic novel style; slate blue-grey, iron grey, olive grey, muted brown, warm desaturated skin, ceramic in pale grey-beige.
